title: Screen Share Live Scanning & Web Discovery
summary: Introduced in-browser live screen sharing and mobile camera scanning, along with improved search discoverability.

changes.text: Live Screen Share: Share any Genshin Impact window or monitor directly in your browser on desktop to scan your inventory without saving or uploading video files.
Mobile Camera Scanning: Point your phone camera at your PC monitor or TV screen to stream and scan inventory in real-time with HUD and duration timers.
Mobile Screen Recording Assistant: Quick guided workflow for scanning recordings made with built-in Android Quick Settings and iOS Control Center.
Instant Snapshot Capture: Snap any frame in real-time from the live stream to scan immediately.
Web Discovery & Guides: Added comprehensive SEO metadata, FAQs, and feature comparison tables for web-based Kamera alternatives.
